title: Analisis Media & Kritikan
canDo: Critically analyse a news article or opinion piece
Identify bias, tone, and rhetorical strategies
Discuss media literacy at an advanced level
lifeBenefit: Think and speak critically about media — a key academic and civic skill at this level.

vocab.example: Artikel ini agak berat sebelah pada satu pihak.

vocab.exampleEn: The tone of this writing is quite emotional.

vocab.example: Penulis guna strategi retorik untuk pujuk pembaca.
vocab.exampleEn: The writer uses rhetorical strategy to persuade readers.

vocab.example: Kita perlu nilai kredibiliti sumber ini.
vocab.exampleEn: We need to assess this source's credibility.

vocab.example: Laporan yang baik ada perspektif berimbang.
vocab.exampleEn: A good report has a balanced perspective.

vocab.example: Saya cuba mengkritik secara membina, bukan menyerang.
vocab.exampleEn: I try to critique constructively, not attack.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'This article's tone is one-sided and emotional.'
practiceExercises.answer: Nada penulisan artikel ini berat sebelah dan emosional.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'What rhetorical strategy does the writer use, and is the source credible?'
practiceExercises.answer: Apa strategi retorik yang penulis guna, dan adakah sumber ini kredibel?

scenario.setting: Critiquing a news opinion piece in a media literacy discussion group

script.ms: Apa pandangan awak tentang nada penulisan artikel ni?
script.en: What's your view on the tone of this article?

script.ms: Saya rasa ia agak berat sebelah dan guna strategi retorik yang emosional.
script.en: I think it's quite one-sided and uses emotional rhetorical strategy.

script.ms: Bagaimana dengan kredibiliti sumber yang dipetik?
script.en: What about the credibility of the sources cited?

script.ms: Sumbernya kurang jelas. Saya rasa perspektif berimbang tiada di sini.
script.en: The sources aren't very clear. I feel there's no balanced perspective here.

script.ms: Bagus. Cuba mengkritik secara membina — apa cadangan penambahbaikan?
script.en: Good. Try to critique constructively — what improvement would you suggest?

scenario.aiPrompt: You are a media literacy discussion facilitator guiding critical analysis of a news article. Ask probing questions about bias, rhetoric, and source credibility, and push the learner toward constructive, not just negative, critique.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the media-critique discussion, focusing on analytical, precise register.
Critique a news article or opinion piece (real or invented) with the AI facilitator persona, addressing bias and credibility.
rubric: offers a constructive suggestion, not just criticism

speakingPrompts.instructions: Deliver a 3-minute critical analysis of a media piece of your choosing, covering tone, bias, and credibility.
rubric: covers all three elements: tone, bias, credibility

questions.prompt: Translate: 'We need to assess this source's credibility.'
questions.answer: Kita perlu nilai kredibiliti sumber ini.
